head: codex/5518-terminal-plan-repair
title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2][closeout] Repair stale terminal plan-step truth atomically
body:
Closes #5518

## Summary
- add a narrow typed terminal plan-step repair for closed-out issue records
- require exact authority scope and receipt/record compare-and-swap truth
- serialize all common terminal receipt writers across worktrees
- fail ordinary lifecycle operations closed while terminal recovery is pending
- repair #5516 SPP S3 and preserve exact terminal receipt parity

## Validation
- focused terminal plan repair unit, Gate 7, and Gate 9 tests pass on FastWork
- all six terminal durability interruption boundaries pass
- strict all-target Clippy, cargo fmt, and git diff checks pass
- exact publication-head subagent review is clean
- csdlc-doctor passes for #5516 and #5518

No Runtime, Runtime v2, or Runtime v3 source changes. No AWS execution.
